notes: BUU 2.0 v2.2.3 - trustworthy reporting release. After every row the worker re-navigates and reads back the fields the flow tried to set; mismatches reclassify ok rows to error with the failing field named (verify-after-action pass, default ON, ~5-15s per row, toggle in pool-launch UI). Every row also writes a diagnostic capture folder (screenshot + gzipped DOM + URL + step trail + console buffer + HTTP responses + dialogs) under logs/failures-<poolId>/ with a per-(status, errorCategory) bucket cap. Dialog text always logged (blanket page.on(dialog) listener; dialogs journaled as discriminated records). Skip/error reclassified: skip is now reserved for user-chosen filtering only; retry-exhaustion returns error. Counter display shows distinctDone headline plus reclaim breakdown by reason (drain/user-stop/breaker/crash). Log retention auto-deletes worker .log, per-worker xlsx, and failure capture dirs older than 30 days at startup. One-click Archive button moves finished spreadsheets to upcoming/Finished/. Bundles v2.2.2 (Tier 2 runtime unification: single-runner deleted, ~1755 lines removed, pool worker is the sole runtime; loginToPestPac deduplicated; pool worker gained step-by-step, network-aware retry, error classification; preload shim bridges legacy renderer APIs to pool equivalents) since v2.2.2 was never released. Built on v2.2.1 (lossless reclaim) and v2.2.0 (read field step). NOT smoke-tested live against PestPac yet - first run on the void-flow that motivated this release is the acceptance test.
